newsitem.title: CHINA: China experts urge set up of state reinsurer.
newsitem.headline: China experts urge set up of state reinsurer.

text.p: Experts from the Reinsurance Company of the huge state-owned People's Insurance Company of China (PICC) have suggested China set up a state reinsurer to curb market disorder and develop a national industry.

The state reinsurance company would be a combination of a policy and commercial insurance firm, mainly dealing with compulsory reinsurance business, and playing the leading role in China's reinsurance market, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.

Under China's insurance law, domestic insurers must distribute 20 percent of the business to PICC Reinsurance to diversify risk. After handing over this compulsory business most insurers are reluctant to give commercial opportunities to PICC Reinsurance.
China plans to establish some policy insurance companies separate from commercial firms to further commercialisation of the insurance industry, XInhua said.
The policy insurance companies to be formed include a company dealing in agricultural insurance, one specialising in export credit insurance and a state reinsurance business.

"It is unfair for other Chinese insurance companies if PICC Reinsurance continues its role as a state reinsurance company, as it is a commercial company," Xinhua quoted one insurance official as saying.
Experts estimate the total income of the reinsurance industry in China's inland areas will be around 23 billion yuan by the end of this century, Xinhua said.
